contact.routing_reason: Official page directs technical questions to the project manager.

operator_questions.needed: Exact DRP 14.0.1 g(T,V) implementation or authoritative confirmation of the temperature sign/centering and housekeeping-field mapping. High-level units/order are now resolved: g is ADU/e-, the bias-corrected image is divided by g to electrons, then linearised without unit change.
operator_questions.source_conflict: The matching EXT_VER=12.1.5 common_sw schema defines system gain in ADU/e- from HK_TEMP_FEE_CCD and writes the temperature term as HK_TEMP_FEE_CCD + TEMP_OFF. CHEOPSim centers physical CCD temperature by subtracting the signed nominal TEMP_OFF. PIPE v1.1 uses VOLT_FEE_CCD as its temperature variable, adds TEMP_OFF, and returns the reciprocal e-/ADU. The executed DRP log reports only ~2.0 e-/ADU; no exact DRP formula is yet public.

drp_architecture_evidence.source: Hoyer et al. 2020, Expected performances of CHEOPS III: Data reduction pipeline
drp_architecture_evidence.result: Section 4.3 defines gain in ADU/e- and Ig=Ib/g(T,V), yielding electrons; section 4.4 applies linearisation afterwards without changing units and explains combined imagette/stack linearisation.

operator_questions.needed: Exact native gcoadd definition for the NEXP=2 imagettes and its numerical relation to ordinary coadd; normalization/grouping/weights, clipping/saturation/rounding, plus bias/gain/LUT order and normalization for the actual exposure stacks.
operator_questions.constraint: Public mission documentation now establishes ordinary window stacking as pixel-by-pixel coaddition and the DPD distinguishes coadd/mean/gmean/gcoadd/none, with gmean/gcoadd used for imagettes. The DPD delegates the exact modes to CHEOPS-UVIE-INST-TN-001 issue 2.0. The official public IASW repository is identified, but the exact gcoadd implementation has not yet been retrieved. The 6048 individual exposure records remain metadata, not individual science image arrays.

operator_questions.needed: Actual V_STRT_U/V_STOP_U headers and the DRP 14.0.1 selection/interpolation rule for the dark and bad-pixel maps on this early visit.
operator_questions.constraint: Archive Obs Start/Stop columns and filenames are not verified native validity headers; no invalid-calibration conclusion is drawn.

reference_inputs.purpose: Offline electron-domain nonlinearity, including interpolation, domain and normalization for the recorded stacking operator.
Exact spatial response, applicable temperature planes and interpolation for T_EFF=5196 K.
MAP correction explicitly applied in the executed log; actual validity headers and early-visit selection rule needed.
Pixel classification and mask semantics with the actual validity headers and early-visit selection rule.
Required only if the prospective estimator depends on this mission PSF reference.

delivery_requirements: Use a supported approved delivery. Do not retry or bypass the previously policy-blocked mission reference-bundle action.

Original exact-version files should retain original headers and provenance. An official flat subset requires source-file identity, original geometry/index convention, selected temperature planes, interpolation rule and derivation provenance.
Set a total byte bound and inspect delivered headers before choosing any regions or temperature planes. Archive MB values here are display strings, not verified byte counts.
After delivery, verify file identity, native checksums, units, applicable hardware and validity/selection semantics before adopting a physical operator.

Then freeze one integrated protected calibration, uncertainty, PSF/background, mask, exposure-integration, 30/60/100-second positive-pulse, nuisance and native-prediction study before evaluating source images.
excluded_as_automatic_dependencies: BiasFrame V0109 solely to replay the spatial correction that the log skipped.
ReadOut V0101 solely to rediscover the already recorded scalar bias/RON defaults.
Aperture V0300 for a method that does not use that reference.

public_source_followup.result: Official public IASW repository identified; DPD and OBDP material confirm the operator family and ordinary coadd context, but a second bounded public-source pass did not recover RD-11 issue 2.0, an indexed flight-relevant gcoadd implementation, native dark/bad validity headers, or the exact flat/LUT contents. Public-source resolution remains incomplete.

gain_public_source_followup.decision: Reference semantics are now resolved by a matching-version public schema; the exact DRP 14.0.1 operator remains unverified.

calibration_order_public_evidence.stacked_linearisation_note: Official DRP paper says individual-readout nonlinearity should be corrected before stacking; when individual readouts are unavailable, imagettes are combined with stacked images with pixel weighting.
